title: SmartGarageToolDefinitions
description: JSON Schema declarations of all available tools for Antigravity Core and Open Interpreter

tools.name: garage_door_control
tools.description: Control garage physical door mechanisms or query their real-time state via ESP32-S3 bridge.

action.description: Action to perform on the door: 'open' to raise door, 'close' to lower door, 'status' to check current state.

tools.name: climate_sensor_read
tools.description: Read temperature, relative humidity, or battery levels from BLE climate sensors and telemetry database.

sensor_type.description: The metric to read: temperature (°C), relative humidity (%), or all metrics.

location.description: Specific sensor location: basement (active Xiaomi LYWSD03MMC), floor_1 (garage), floor_2 (living area), or all.

history_hours.description: Optional telemetry history timeframe in hours (e.g. 24 for 24h average/trend).

tools.name: audio_control
tools.description: Manage Smart Garage audio playback, Bluetooth speakers (JX-BT, JBL Clip 5), projector audio, and volume levels.

target_device.description: Audio output target: 'jx_bt' (1st floor speaker), 'jbl_clip5' (garage speaker), 'projector' (HY350MAX), or 'all'.

query.description: Search query for internet radio station (e.g., 'kiss_fm', 'hit_fm') or track name when action is 'play'.

volume_percent.description: Target volume percentage (0-100). Recommended baseline is 80% to bypass hardware noise gates.

tools.name: docker_container_manage
tools.description: Inspect, start, stop, restart, or retrieve logs from local Docker containers in the smart garage environment.

tail_lines.description: Number of recent log lines to retrieve when action is 'logs'.

tools.name: file_operations
tools.description: Safe, non-destructive file operations strictly within the /home/user/smartgarage/ directory tree.

operation.description: File operation: 'read' content, 'write' text, 'list' directory contents, or check if file 'exists'.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path. Must reside inside /home/user/smartgarage/ (or workspace root).

content.description: String content to write when operation is 'write'.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to read when operation is 'read'.
